About

Emcee of the afrofusion collective K.O.G. & The Zongo Brigade and the jazz fusion group TC & The Groove Family. His solo project brings his own mix of Afro, hip-hop and jazz to the stage with a razor-sharp band.

Highlights

  • Emcee of K.O.G. & The Zongo Brigade
  • Emcee of TC & The Groove Family (2023 UK tour)
  • Solo project launched in 2024
